setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 3000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (4, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['title'] = [f'item_{i:04d}' for i in range(n)]

steps.name: set label and color column to cluster
steps.eval: const col = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'cluster'); a.setLabelColumn(col.index); a.setColorColumn(col.index)
steps.until: a.labels.column !== null && a.colorColumn !== null && a.colorMeta !== null

steps.name: verify stub got label_color_map
steps.eval: const res = await fetch('/exec', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'assert len(_dmp_calls) > 0 and _dmp_calls[-1]["label_color_map"] is not None, f"expected label_color_map in call, got {_dmp_calls}"' }) }); window.__dmpCheck = (await res.json()).ok;
